name: KAZE (風)
tagline: The Weightless Static Site Generator for Python
description: Zero pip dependencies. 100% Python standard library. 0.01-second instant compilation. Pure static HTML edge-cached on Cloudflare.

services.title: Zero Dependencies
services.description: Built 100% on Python standard library. No pip install, no virtualenv breakages, no upstream supply-chain risks.

services.title: Sub-10ms Compilation
services.description: Token substitution and native regex markdown parsing compiles multi-page sites in less than a single screen refresh.

services.title: Decoupled Editorial
services.description: Edit raw JSON and Markdown files directly in VS Code, Obsidian, or an optional zero-cost visual browser CMS.

services.title: Edge Static Security
services.description: Pure semantic HTML and CSS with zero server runtime or database vulnerabilities, cached globally at CDN edge.
